events.label: Miles Morales bitten; becomes Spider-Man in Earth-1610
events.description: Brooklyn teenager Miles Morales is bitten by a strange spider and starts developing the same amazing abilities as the city's famous hero - just as that hero is killed.

events.label: Kingpin's collider punches holes between universes
events.description: The crime boss Kingpin builds an enormous underground machine to punch through to other worlds, hoping to find another version of his dead family - but each test tears dangerous holes between the universes.

events.label: Gwen and other Spiders fall into Miles's world
events.description: The machine goes off, and other people with spider powers from different worlds tumble into Miles's New York - including a masked girl called Gwen, who swings straight into his life.

events.label: Spider-gang meets Miles; dimension decay clocks
events.description: The stranded spider-heroes find Miles and compare notes: every hour they stay in the wrong world, their bodies start coming apart. They must get home fast or die here.

events.label: Training montage; Miles not ready per Peter B
events.description: Peter, a worn-out older Spider-Man from another world, tries to teach Miles to control his powers - wall-crawling, webs, the lot - but everything Miles tries comes out wrong.

events.label: Prowler/Uncle Aaron tragedy; Miles's leap of faith
events.description: Miles discovers his beloved Uncle Aaron is really a masked criminal, and watches him die protecting Miles from his own employer. Grief finally unlocks Miles's true power.

events.label: Spiders try to leave Miles behind for his safety
events.description: The other spider-heroes decide Miles is too untrained to survive the coming fight, so they leave him behind locked in his room while they go after Kingpin themselves.

events.label: Miles masters powers; collider battle with Kingpin
events.description: Miles breaks free, and in the final battle inside the machine's chamber his powers finally come alive - he is strong enough to turn the machine against itself and face Kingpin.

events.label: Spiders returned to home universes via go-home machine
events.description: Once the danger is past, the spider-heroes step back through the machine one by one, each returning to their own world as the hole between the universes is closed.

events.label: Miles claims his city's Spider-Man mantle
events.description: With the visitors gone, Miles takes up the mask for real: he is Brooklyn's own Spider-Man now, protecting his friends and his city.

events.label: Glitching as cost of off-world presence
events.description: Anyone from another world slowly comes apart in the wrong universe, flickering and glitching like a broken screen - a constant reminder that they don't belong here.

events.label: Multiverse of Spider-people affirmed
events.description: Miles learns the truth behind the comics: there are many worlds, and in each one someone wears the mask - he is simply this world's version.

events.label: Kingpin collider experiment
events.description: Kingpin's giant machine is switched on beneath the city, punching holes in the walls between worlds in his desperate bid to reach a lost family.

events.label: Miles bitten; spider powers
events.description: A spider from another world bites Miles and changes him: he can cling to walls, and a hidden strength is waking up in him.

events.label: Spider-people from other dimensions
events.description: Strangers in other Spider-Man costumes arrive in Miles's world, each one a different person from a different universe who happens to have the same powers.

events.label: Peter B. mentors Miles
events.description: Peter, an older and jaded Spider-Man stranded far from home, reluctantly takes Miles under his wing and shows him what being Spider-Man costs.

events.label: Gwen band / alliance
events.description: Gwen, the Spider-Woman of her own city, bonds with Miles and rallies the stranded heroes into a team willing to fight for a world that is not theirs.

events.label: Stop collider destroying city
events.description: The heroes storm Kingpin's machine before its next test destroys all of New York, fighting their way to the controls while the sky tears open above the city.

events.label: Miles leap of faith
events.description: At the heart of the story, Miles stops hesitating: he leaps off a skyscraper, trusts his powers, and catches himself on a web of his own making.

events.label: Variants return; Miles remains
events.description: The machine sends every visitor home to their own world safely, and Miles stays behind - the one and only Spider-Man of this Brooklyn.

ruleEffects.effect: Shutting collider ends forced contact; Spiders return home

outcome.summary: Miles becomes Spider-Man of 1610; visiting Spiders go home; multiverse confirmed.
